gram.d: Chinese groups big numbers by 萬 (10,000), not thousands: 一萬 = 10,000, 十萬 = 100,000, 百萬 = a million. Prices, salaries, and news numbers all run on 萬 — retrain your inner accountant.

qs.q: Where is the ATM?

What's the most important last step?
ch: Take both the money AND the card

gram.d: 就好 caps a choice at 'that's enough': 領兩千就好 just 2,000 is fine, 洗剪吹就好 just the basic service. The polite limiter that ends upsells and oversized plans alike.

gram.d: 連 X 都 Y = even X does Y: 連開戶都要蓋章 — even opening an account needs a stamp; 連週末都在工作 — working even on weekends. The pattern for surprising extremes.

qs.q: How fast did Mr. Wang reply to the revised contract?

gram.d: Time/limit + 內 = within: 三十天內付清 pay in full within 30 days, 24小時內回覆 reply within 24 hours, 預算內 within budget. Contract Chinese draws its deadlines with 內.

scenarios.who: 便利商店店員 Store Clerk (calling)
scenarios.intro: Your phone rings with the best possible bad news: someone found your wallet. Describe it, claim it, and remember why Taiwan's honesty is legendary.

them.zh: 先生你好，這裡是便利商店。你是不是掉了東西？
them.py: Xiānshēng nǐ hǎo, zhèlǐ shì biànlì shāngdiàn. Nǐ shì bú shì diào le dōngxi?
them.en: Hello sir, this is the convenience store. Did you drop something?

turns.task: Ask — is it a wallet? Yours is gone!

ans.zh: 是錢包嗎？我的錢包不見了！
ans.py: Shì qiánbāo ma? Wǒ de qiánbāo bújiàn le!
ans.en: Is it a wallet? Mine is gone!

them.zh: 對！請問你的錢包是什麼顏色的？
them.py: Duì! Qǐngwèn nǐ de qiánbāo shì shénme yánsè de?
them.en: Yes! What color is your wallet?

turns.task: Describe it: black, with a thousand-something inside and an EasyCard.

ans.zh: 黑色的，裡面有一千多塊，還有一張悠遊卡。
ans.py: Hēisè de, lǐmiàn yǒu yìqiān duō kuài, háiyǒu yì zhāng Yōuyóukǎ.
ans.en: Black — a thousand-something inside, plus an EasyCard.

them.zh: 沒錯，就是這個！你可以來店裡拿。
them.py: Méicuò, jiùshì zhège! Nǐ kěyǐ lái diàn lǐ ná.
them.en: That's the one! You can come pick it up.

turns.task: You'll come right away — ask what to bring.

ans.zh: 太好了，我馬上過去！要帶什麼嗎？
ans.py: Tài hǎo le, wǒ mǎshàng guòqù! Yào dài shénme ma?
ans.en: Amazing — I'll come right now! Should I bring anything?

them.zh: 帶證件就可以了。
them.py: Dài zhèngjiàn jiù kěyǐ le.
them.en: Just bring some ID.

turns.task: Got it — ID it is. Thank them so much!

ans.zh: 好，我帶證件。真的很謝謝你！
ans.py: Hǎo, wǒ dài zhèngjiàn. Zhēnde hěn xièxie nǐ!
ans.en: Got it, ID. Thank you so much!

them.zh: 不會！以後東西要收好喔！
them.py: Bú huì! Yǐhòu dōngxi yào shōu hǎo o!
them.en: Of course! Keep your things safe from now on!

turns.task: They're so kind — say you're on your way!

ans.zh: 你人真好！我馬上到，等一下見！
ans.py: Nǐ rén zhēn hǎo! Wǒ mǎshàng dào, děng yíxià jiàn!
ans.en: You're so kind! On my way — see you soon!

scenarios.who: 同事小陳 Coworker Xiao Chen
scenarios.intro: Reunited with your wallet, you need cash. Handle the cross-bank fee question — and the beeping machine that has ended a thousand cards.

them.zh: 你要領錢喔？便利商店裡面就有提款機。
them.py: Nǐ yào lǐngqián o? Biànlì shāngdiàn lǐmiàn jiù yǒu tíkuǎnjī.
them.en: Need cash? There's an ATM right in the convenience store.

turns.task: Yes — ask whether cross-bank withdrawals have a fee.

ans.zh: 對。請問跨行領錢要手續費嗎？
ans.py: Duì. Qǐngwèn kuàháng lǐngqián yào shǒuxùfèi ma?
ans.en: Yes — is there a fee for cross-bank withdrawals?

them.zh: 要，五塊而已啦。你要領多少？
them.py: Yào, wǔ kuài éryǐ la. Nǐ yào lǐng duōshǎo?
them.en: Yeah, just five bucks. How much are you taking out?

turns.task: Two thousand is plenty.

ans.zh: 領兩千就好。
ans.py: Lǐng liǎngqiān jiù hǎo.
ans.en: Two thousand's plenty.

them.zh: 好了嗎？欸——機器在叫欸！
them.py: Hǎo le ma? Éi — jīqì zài jiào éi!
them.en: Done? Hey — the machine's beeping at you!

turns.task: Oh no — you took the cash but forgot the card!

ans.zh: 啊！我拿了錢，忘記拿卡了！
ans.py: A! Wǒ ná le qián, wàngjì ná kǎ le!
ans.en: Ah! I took the cash and forgot the card!

them.zh: 哈哈快拿！十個人有九個都這樣。
them.py: Hāhā kuài ná! Shí ge rén yǒu jiǔ ge dōu zhèyàng.
them.en: Haha grab it! Nine out of ten people do that.

turns.task: Got it — that was close! Thank him.

ans.zh: 拿到了，好險！謝謝你！
ans.py: Nádào le, hǎo xiǎn! Xièxie nǐ!
ans.en: Got it — close one! Thanks!

them.zh: 走吧。欸，這個星期你跟錢真的很有緣。
them.py: Zǒu ba. Éi, zhège xīngqí nǐ gēn qián zhēnde hěn yǒuyuán.
them.en: Let's go. Man, you and money have quite the relationship this week.

turns.task: Laugh it off: first the wallet, now the card — your money keeps trying to escape!

ans.zh: 哈哈，先是錢包，現在是卡，我的錢一直想逃走！
ans.py: Hāhā, xiān shì qiánbāo, xiànzài shì kǎ, wǒ de qián yìzhí xiǎng táozǒu!
ans.en: Haha — first the wallet, now the card. My money keeps trying to escape!

scenarios.intro: Salary needs a local home. Present your documents, discover the chop requirement, solve it like a local, and walk out with your first Taiwanese account.

them.zh: 您好，請問要辦什麼業務？
them.py: Nín hǎo, qǐngwèn yào bàn shénme yèwù?
them.en: Hello — what can I help you with today?

turns.task: Say you'd like to open an account.

ans.zh: 你好，我想開一個帳戶。
ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng kāi yíge zhànghù.
ans.en: Hi — I'd like to open an account.

them.zh: 好的。請問有帶護照跟居留證嗎？
them.py: Hǎo de. Qǐngwèn yǒu dài hùzhào gēn jūliúzhèng ma?
them.en: Sure. Do you have your passport and ARC?

turns.task: Yes — hand both over.

ans.zh: 有，護照跟居留證都在這裡。
ans.py: Yǒu, hùzhào gēn jūliúzhèng dōu zài zhèlǐ.
ans.en: Yes — passport and ARC, right here.

them.zh: 謝謝。還需要一個印章喔。
them.py: Xièxie. Hái xūyào yíge yìnzhāng o.
them.en: Thanks. You'll also need a chop.

turns.task: You don't have one! Ask what to do.

ans.zh: 印章？我沒有印章，怎麼辦？
ans.py: Yìnzhāng? Wǒ méiyǒu yìnzhāng, zěnme bàn?
ans.en: A chop? I don't have one — what do I do?

them.zh: 沒關係，對面就有刻印章的店，十五分鐘就好了。
them.py: Méi guānxi, duìmiàn jiù yǒu kè yìnzhāng de diàn, shíwǔ fēnzhōng jiù hǎo le.
them.en: No worries — there's a chop-carving shop right across the street. Fifteen minutes.

turns.task: Perfect — you'll go carve one and come right back.

ans.zh: 太好了，我去刻一個，馬上回來！
ans.py: Tài hǎo le, wǒ qù kè yíge, mǎshàng huílái!
ans.en: Perfect — I'll go carve one and be right back!

them.zh: 好的，回來抽號碼牌就可以了。
them.py: Hǎo de, huílái chōu hàomǎpái jiù kěyǐ le.
them.en: Great — just grab a number ticket when you're back.

turns.task: Thank them — marvel that in Taiwan, even opening an account needs a chop!

ans.zh: 謝謝！在台灣，連開戶都要印章，太有趣了！
ans.py: Xièxie! Zài Táiwān, lián kāihù dōu yào yìnzhāng, tài yǒuqù le!
ans.en: Thanks! In Taiwan even opening an account takes a chop — I love it!

scenarios.who: 客戶王先生 Client Mr. Wang
scenarios.intro: The revised contract landed well — now the money mechanics. Hold your deposit number with a reason, meet in the middle, and lock the signing date.

them.zh: Eric！修改的合約我看過了，寫得很清楚。
them.py: Eric! Xiūgǎi de héyuē wǒ kàn guò le, xiě de hěn qīngchǔ.
them.en: Eric! I've read the revised contract — very clearly written.

turns.task: Glad to hear it — ask whether the payment terms are acceptable.

ans.zh: 太好了！請問付款的條件您可以接受嗎？
ans.py: Tài hǎo le! Qǐngwèn fùkuǎn de tiáojiàn nín kěyǐ jiēshòu ma?
ans.en: Great! Are the payment terms acceptable to you?

them.zh: 大部分可以。不過訂金百分之三十有點高，百分之二十如何？
them.py: Dàbùfèn kěyǐ. Búguò dìngjīn bǎifēnzhī sānshí yǒudiǎn gāo, bǎifēnzhī èrshí rúhé?
them.en: Mostly yes. But a 30% deposit is a bit high — how about 20%?

turns.task: Hold with a reason: custom parts must be ordered right after signing — propose meeting halfway at 25%.

ans.zh: 因為零件要在簽約後馬上訂做，我們各退一步，訂金百分之二十五如何？
ans.py: Yīnwèi língjiàn yào zài qiānyuē hòu mǎshàng dìngzuò, wǒmen gè tuì yí bù, dìngjīn bǎifēnzhī èrshíwǔ rúhé?
ans.en: The custom parts must be ordered right after signing — let's each step back: 25%?

them.zh: 哈哈，你越來越會談了！好，二十五就二十五。尾款呢？
them.py: Hāhā, nǐ yuèláiyuè huì tán le! Hǎo, èrshíwǔ jiù èrshíwǔ. Wěikuǎn ne?
them.en: Haha, you're getting good at this! Fine — 25 it is. And the balance?

turns.task: State it precisely: balance wired in full within 30 days after delivery and acceptance.

ans.zh: 尾款在交貨驗收以後，三十天內匯款付清。
ans.py: Wěikuǎn zài jiāohuò yànshōu yǐhòu, sānshí tiān nèi huìkuǎn fùqīng.
ans.en: The balance is wired in full within thirty days after delivery and acceptance.

them.zh: 可以。那簽約就定下個月十號，我們高雄見？
them.py: Kěyǐ. Nà qiānyuē jiù dìng xià ge yuè shí hào, wǒmen Gāoxióng jiàn?
them.en: Agreed. Then the signing is set — the 10th of next month, see you in Kaohsiung?

turns.task: Seal it: it's a deal — the 10th in Kaohsiung; thank him for being such a good partner.

ans.zh: 一言為定，下個月十號高雄見！謝謝您這麼好合作。
ans.py: Yì yán wéi dìng, xià ge yuè shí hào Gāoxióng jiàn! Xièxie nín zhème hǎo hézuò.
ans.en: It's a deal — the 10th, in Kaohsiung! Thank you for being such a great partner.

them.zh: 跟你們做生意很愉快！代我問候小陳跟你們主管！
them.py: Gēn nǐmen zuò shēngyì hěn yúkuài! Dài wǒ wènhòu Xiǎo Chén gēn nǐmen zhǔguǎn!
them.en: A pleasure doing business! Send my regards to Xiao Chen and your boss!

turns.task: Will do — next stop: the signing table!

ans.zh: 一定轉達！下一站，簽約桌上見！
ans.py: Yídìng zhuǎndá! Xià yí zhàn, qiānyuē zhuō shàng jiàn!
ans.en: I'll pass it on! Next stop — the signing table!

scenarios.intro: Tonight's OPI drill: map the winners and losers of currency appreciation, weigh the central bank's dilemma, and show how a small company actually manages FX risk — your own contract as the case study.

them.zh: 台幣最近升值，大家都在討論。你覺得誰是贏家，誰是輸家？
them.py: Táibì zuìjìn shēngzhí, dàjiā dōu zài tǎolùn. Nǐ juéde shéi shì yíngjiā, shéi shì shūjiā?
them.en: The NT keeps rising and everyone's talking. Who wins and who loses?

turns.task: Map it: winners are importers, travelers, consumers; losers are exporters, whose dollars convert to fewer NT.

ans.zh: 贏家是進口商、出國的人跟消費者；輸家是外銷業者，收到的美元換成台幣變少了。
ans.py: Yíngjiā shì jìnkǒushāng, chūguó de rén gēn xiāofèizhě; shūjiā shì wàixiāo yèzhě, shōudào de měiyuán huàn chéng Táibì biàn shǎo le.
ans.en: Winners: importers, travelers, consumers. Losers: exporters — their dollars now convert to fewer NT.

them.zh: 那央行應該出手讓台幣貶值嗎？
them.py: Nà yāngháng yīnggāi chūshǒu ràng Táibì biǎnzhí ma?
them.en: Should the central bank step in and push the NT down?

turns.task: Frame the dilemma: intervene and you invite trade-partner pressure plus pricier imports; don't, and exporters bleed — argue stability matters more than direction.

ans.zh: 這是兩難：出手會有貿易夥伴的壓力，進口也變貴；不出手，外銷就辛苦。我認為重點是穩定，不是方向。
ans.py: Zhè shì liǎngnán: chūshǒu huì yǒu màoyì huǒbàn de yālì, jìnkǒu yě biàn guì; bù chūshǒu, wàixiāo jiù xīnkǔ. Wǒ rènwéi zhòngdiǎn shì wěndìng, búshì fāngxiàng.
ans.en: It's a dilemma: intervene and you get trade-partner pressure and costlier imports; don't, and exporters suffer. The point is stability, not direction.

them.zh: 對你們公司有什麼影響？
them.py: Duì nǐmen gōngsī yǒu shénme yǐngxiǎng?
them.en: How does it affect your company?

turns.task: Get specific: your components import in US dollars, so appreciation makes them cheaper — and this contract is priced in NT, so the deal is insulated; that's exactly why NT-denominated contracts cut risk.

ans.zh: 我們的零件用美元進口，升值反而讓成本變低；而且這次的合約用台幣計價，幾乎不受影響——這就是用台幣簽約降低風險的好處。
ans.py: Wǒmen de língjiàn yòng měiyuán jìnkǒu, shēngzhí fǎn'ér ràng chéngběn biàn dī; érqiě zhècì de héyuē yòng Táibì jìjià, jīhū bú shòu yǐngxiǎng — zhè jiùshì yòng Táibì qiānyuē jiàngdī fēngxiǎn de hǎochù.
ans.en: Our components import in USD, so appreciation actually lowers costs — and this contract is priced in NT, so it's insulated. That's the point of NT-denominated deals: lower risk.

turns.keys: 零件美元台幣計價風險

them.zh: 那你會給其他中小企業什麼建議？
them.py: Nà nǐ huì gěi qítā zhōngxiǎo qǐyè shénme jiànyì?
them.en: What would you advise other SMEs?

turns.task: Three tools: quote in the customer's currency when possible, match costs and revenue in the same currency, and build a small buffer into every quote.

ans.zh: 三個方法：盡量用客戶的貨幣報價、讓成本跟收入用同一種貨幣，還有在每一份報價裡留一點緩衝空間。
ans.py: Sān ge fāngfǎ: jǐnliàng yòng kèhù de huòbì bàojià, ràng chéngběn gēn shōurù yòng tóng yì zhǒng huòbì, háiyǒu zài měi yí fèn bàojià lǐ liú yìdiǎn huǎnchōng kōngjiān.
ans.en: Three tools: quote in the customer's currency where possible, match costs and revenue in one currency, and keep a small buffer in every quote.

them.zh: 非常實用！謝謝你今天的分享！
them.py: Fēicháng shíyòng! Xièxie nǐ jīntiān de fēnxiǎng!
them.en: Extremely practical — thanks for sharing tonight!

turns.task: Close with the line: exchange rates move every day, but trust, once built, doesn't fluctuate.

ans.zh: 謝謝主持人！匯率天天在變，但是信任建立了，就不會波動。
ans.py: Xièxie zhǔchírén! Huìlǜ tiāntiān zài biàn, dànshì xìnrèn jiànlì le, jiù bú huì bōdòng.
ans.en: Thank you! Exchange rates move daily — but trust, once built, doesn't fluctuate.

x: 我的錢包放在包包裡。
Wǒ de qiánbāo fàng zài bāobāo lǐ.
My wallet is in my bag.
vocab.n: Lost-and-found Taiwan is famously honest — wallets routinely come back, cash intact.

x: 這件外套兩千塊。
Zhè jiàn wàitào liǎngqiān kuài.
This jacket is two thousand.
vocab.n: 兩千 not 二千 in speech. 千萬 together = 'whatever you do…': 千萬不要遲到！

x: 這台機車八萬塊。
Zhè tái jīchē bā wàn kuài.
This scooter is eighty thousand.
vocab.n: THE number pivot: Chinese counts in 萬, not thousands. 100,000 = 十萬, a million = 百萬. Drill until automatic.

x: 我每個月存一萬塊。
Wǒ měige yuè cún yíwàn kuài.
I save ten thousand a month.
vocab.n: 存錢 save money, 存款 deposits/savings, 存起來 put it away. Digital files also get 存 (saved).

x: 我先去領錢再吃飯。
Wǒ xiān qù lǐngqián zài chīfàn.
Let me withdraw money before we eat.
vocab.n: Taiwan says 領錢; the mainland says 取錢. 領 also collects salaries (領薪水) and packages (領包裹).

x: 我先查一下帳戶的餘額。
Wǒ xiān chá yíxià zhànghù de yú'é.
Let me check my account balance first.
vocab.n: 餘額不足 = insufficient balance — the EasyCard beep of shame at every MRT gate.

x: 跨行領錢要手續費五塊。
Kuàháng lǐngqián yào shǒuxùfèi wǔ kuài.
Cross-bank withdrawals cost a five-dollar fee.
vocab.n: 跨 = to straddle across: 跨行 interbank, 跨國 multinational, 跨年 the New Year countdown.

x: 跨行轉帳要手續費。
Kuàháng zhuǎnzhàng yào shǒuxùfèi.
Cross-bank transfers carry a fee.
vocab.n: 手續 = procedures + 費 fee. Banks, tickets, exchanges — always ask 有手續費嗎？

x: 外國人開戶要帶居留證。
Wàiguórén kāihù yào dài jūliúzhèng.
Foreigners need an ARC to open an account.
vocab.n: 開 opens more than doors: 開戶 accounts, 開會 meetings, 開刀 surgery, 開玩笑 jokes.

x: 尾款請匯款到這個帳戶。
Wěikuǎn qǐng huìkuǎn dào zhège zhànghù.
Please wire the balance to this account.
vocab.n: 匯 = to converge/remit: 匯款 wire, 匯率 exchange rate, 外匯 forex — one character, your whole finance chapter.

x: 定存的利息比較高。
Dìngcún de lìxī bǐjiào gāo.
Fixed deposits earn higher interest.
vocab.n: 利率 = the interest RATE; 利息 = the money itself. 高利貸 = loan-sharking — avoid.

x: 開戶跟簽約都可能用到印章。
Kāihù gēn qiānyuē dōu kěnéng yòngdào yìnzhāng.
Accounts and contracts may both require your chop.
vocab.n: Taiwan's parallel signature system: banks, leases, registered mail. 蓋章 = to stamp it. Carve yours for ~NT$200.

x: 請問付款方式有哪些？
Qǐngwèn fùkuǎn fāngshì yǒu nǎxiē?
What payment methods are available?
vocab.n: 款 = a sum: 付款 pay, 貨款 payment for goods, 收款 receive payment. 付款條件 = payment terms.

x: 這台手機可以分期付款。
Zhè tái shǒujī kěyǐ fēnqí fùkuǎn.
This phone can be paid in installments.
vocab.n: 分期付款 = installment plan; 零利率分期 (0% installments) is every Taiwanese retailer's favorite hook.

x: 簽約的時候付百分之二十五的訂金。
Qiānyuē de shíhòu fù bǎifēnzhī èrshíwǔ de dìngjīn.
A 25% deposit is paid at signing.
vocab.n: Also for apartments and custom cakes. Legal fine print: 訂金 is usually refundable, 定金 is not — Taiwan contracts care.

x: 驗收以後三十天內付尾款。
Yànshōu yǐhòu sānshí tiān nèi fù wěikuǎn.
The balance is due within 30 days after acceptance.
vocab.n: 尾 = tail: the money at the end. 收尾款 = collect the balance — the sweetest phrase in project work.

x: 業者希望匯率不要波動太大。
Yèzhě xīwàng huìlǜ búyào bōdòng tài dà.
Businesses hope the exchange rate won't swing too much.
vocab.n: 波 = wave: 匯率波動 currency swings, 股市波動 market volatility — finance-news furniture.

x: 央行表示將密切注意匯率。
Yāngháng biǎoshì jiāng mìqiè zhùyì huìlǜ.
The central bank says it will watch the rate closely.
vocab.n: Short for 中央銀行. Every economy headline's protagonist: 央行升息 rate hike, 央行降息 rate cut.

x: 台幣升值，出國變便宜了。
Táibì shēngzhí, chūguó biàn piányí le.
With the NT up, going abroad got cheaper.
vocab.n: 升 rise + 值 value. Also for assets and people: 這個經驗讓你升值 — that experience raises your market value.

x: 日圓貶值，去日本玩的人變多了。
Rìyuán biǎnzhí, qù Rìběn wán de rén biàn duō le.
With the yen down, Japan trips boomed.
vocab.n: The pair 升值/貶值 anchors every currency headline. 通貨膨脹讓錢貶值 — inflation devalues money itself.

x: 月底又吃泡麵，標準月光族。
Yuèdǐ yòu chī pàomiàn, biāozhǔn yuèguāngzú.
Instant noodles again at month's end — textbook paycheck-to-paycheck.
slang.n: 每月花光 'spent by month's end' + 族 tribe. Taiwan-coined, now pan-Chinese. The -族 suffix builds demographics: 上班族, 低頭族.

x: 小資族最愛高CP值的餐廳。
Xiǎozīzú zuì ài gāo CP zhí de cāntīng.
Young professionals live for high-value restaurants.
slang.n: Taiwan marketing-speak: 小資 = small capital. The demographic every 促銷 campaign targets.

x: 他們家是好野人，房子有三層樓。
Tāmen jiā shì hó-gia̍h-lâng, fángzi yǒu sān céng lóu.
Their family's loaded — a three-story house.
slang.n: Hokkien 好額人 'has-plenty person.' Teasing friends who pick up the bill: 哇，好野人欸！

x: 買完高鐵票跟禮物，我這個月要吃土了。
Mǎi wán gāotiě piào gēn lǐwù, wǒ zhège yuè yào chītǔ le.
After HSR tickets and gifts, it's dirt for dinner this month.
slang.n: Mainland shopping-festival slang, fully current in Taiwan. The natural sequel to 剁手.

x: 股票一買就跌，我就是韭菜。
Gǔpiào yì mǎi jiù diē, wǒ jiùshì jiǔcài.
Stocks drop the second I buy — I'm certified leek.
slang.n: Mainland finance slang: leeks regrow after every cutting, and so do small investors. 割韭菜 = harvesting the naive.
